name: The Variant Discovered by Resolute Brigada Clutching Eagle Talon

system.description: As her foe comes forward, the character seizes his weapon and effortlessly twists it out of his grasp. All penalties to the martial artist's Parry DV are eliminated, and she may block lethal damage barehanded without a stunt. If she successfully parries an attack, then her opponent's player must roll against a disarm attempt as if she obtained successes on the roll equal to her Martial Arts. If her opponent is unarmed, then he finds the character has grabbed his wrist and pulled him into a grapple (see Exalted, p. 157). The martial artist must have one hand free in order to use this Charm.
